title: galbanum involucratum
intro: Galbanum involucratum, commonly known as Galbanum, is a perennial plant species in the genus Ferula, which is native to the Middle East and Central Asia. The health benefits of Galbanum involucratum include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Galbanum involucratum include its ability to stimulate the digestive system, relieve digestive issues like indigestion and bloating, and also act as an expectorant to help clear mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Galbanum involucratum include volatile oils, particularly galbanic acid, ferulic acid, and other terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
